title: Voyag: Joint Multi-Intent Detection and Execution-Relation Classification for In-Vehicle Voice Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2611.30253v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An in-vehicle voice assistant must decide not only which intents an utterance contains but also how co-active intents may be executed: concurrently, in a fixed order, or not at all without arbitration. We present Voyag, a single-forward decision model that jointly predicts ten controlled vehicle-intent slots and a three-way execution relation (parallel, sequential, mutually exclusive) over each co-active intent pair. Voyag combines a multilingual ModernBERT-style encoder (mmBERT-base, 306.9M parameters), a typed per-slot choice head, and a lightweight GroupCalibration relation head (1.61M parameters) that consumes marker hidden states, pooled context, explicit resource-requirement profiles, and symmetrized outer-product conflict features. All objectives are optimized in one joint loss: soft cross-entropy over slot choices, focal cross-entropy over relations, and a mutex-consistency penalty. On a synthetic Chinese vehicle-life benchmark

translated_title: Voyag：面向车载语音助手的联合多意图检测与执行关系分类
translated_abstract: 车载语音助手不仅需要判断一句话中包含哪些意图，还需要决定这些共现意图应如何执行：并发执行、按固定顺序执行，或者在不做仲裁的情况下完全不执行。我们提出了 Voyag，一种单次前向的决策模型，能够联合预测十个受控的车载意图槽位，以及每对共现意图之间的三分类执行关系（并行、顺序、互斥）。Voyag 结合了一个多语言 ModernBERT 风格的编码器（mmBERT-base，3.069 亿参数）、一个带类型的逐槽位选择头，以及一个轻量级的 GroupCalibration 关系头（161 万参数），该关系头接收标记隐藏状态、池化上下文、显式资源需求特征以及对称化外积冲突特征作为输入。所有目标均在一个联合损失中优化：槽位选择上的软交叉熵、关系上的焦点交叉熵，以及互斥一致性惩罚项。在合成的中文车生活基准测试上
tldr: Voyag 是一个单次前向的联合决策模型，在车载语音助手场景中同时预测十个车载意图槽位和每对共现意图之间的三分类执行关系（并行、顺序、互斥），并通过统一联合损失进行端到端优化。
en_tdlr: Voyag is a single-forward joint decision model for in-vehicle voice assistants that simultaneously predicts ten vehicle-intent slots and a three-way execution relation (parallel, sequential, mutually exclusive) for each co-active intent pair, optimized end-to-end with a unified joint loss.
